raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Plant-Powered Muscle Gain"

TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Muscle hypertrophy and strength with vegan nutrition integration"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper body hypertrophy A":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Bench press (barbell) 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Seated row machine 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell incline press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell lateral raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest stretch 60 seconds
          lats stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Tuesday training 45m "Lower body hypertrophy A":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Back squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Leg press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Calf raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring stretch 60 seconds
         Quad stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Upper body hypertrophy B":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Overhead press (barbell) 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Dumbbell row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell flyes 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated cable row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Face pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder mobility 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower body hypertrophy B":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Front squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Hip thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Bulgarian split squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds each leg
          Leg extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Seated calf raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip flexor stretch 60 seconds
          calf stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Upper power hypertrophy A":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Bench press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 130 seconds
          Barbell row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 110 seconds
          Incline dumbbell press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pull-ups or assisted pull-ups 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Lateral raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder mobility 60 seconds
      DAY Tuesday training 50m "Lower power hypertrophy A":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Back squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 130 seconds
          Deadlift (sumo or conventional) 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 130 seconds
          Leg press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Calf raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Thursday training 65m "Upper power hypertrophy B":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Overhead press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 130 seconds
          Pendlay row or chest-supported row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 110 seconds
          Dumbbell floor press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Face pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Tricep extension 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder mobility 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower power hypertrophy B":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Front squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 130 seconds
          Hip thrust 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 130 seconds
          Bulgarian split squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Leg curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated calf raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip flexor stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Upper volume push/pull":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Bench press 5x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Barbell row 5x6..10 rpe 7 rest 110 seconds
          Incline dumbbell press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pull-ups or lat pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell lateral raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest/shoulder mobility 120 seconds
      DAY Tuesday training 50m "Lower volume strength":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Back squat 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          Romanian deadlift 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          Leg press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Calf raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring/knee mobility 60 seconds
      DAY Thursday training 65m "Upper accessoryDensity":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Overhead press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Dumbbell row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 110 seconds
          Chest fly 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Face pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Tricep pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder mobility 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower accessoryDensity":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Front squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Hip thrust 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Bulgarian split squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Leg curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip/knee mobility 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Maximal strength maintenance":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Bench press 3x3..5 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          Barbell row 3x3..5 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          Overhead press 3x4..6 rpe 9 rest 150 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 120 seconds
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Lower strength maintenance":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Back squat 3x3..5 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          Deadlift 3x3..5 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          Leg press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring/knee mobility 120 seconds
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Upper accessory maintenance":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Incline dumbbell press 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 110 seconds
          Dumbbell lateral raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Face pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder mobility 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower accessory maintenance":
        warmup:
          cardio 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Front squat 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Hip thrust 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Leg extension 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Seated calf raise 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip/knee mobility 60 seconds

NUTRITION_PLAN
  PLATFORM vegan
  DAILY_PROTEIN_GOAL 150g
  ENERGY_SURPLUS target 250-500 kcal above maintenance (adjust for progress)
  PROTEIN_SOURCES:
    - tofu
    - tempeh
    - seitan
    - edamame
    - lentils
    - chickpeas
    - black beans
    - quinoa
    - soy milk/pea protein powders
  CARBS:
    aim 2.5-4.0 g/kg/day distributed around training
  FATS:
    0.8-1.2 g/kg/day from plant fats
  MEAL_STRUCTURE_SAMPLE:
    - Meal 1: 40–50g protein, 70–90g carbs, fats moderate
    - Meal 2: 40–50g protein, 60–80g carbs
    - Meal 3: 40–50g protein, 40–60g carbs
    - Snack: 20–30g protein
  SUPPLEMENTATION:
    - Creatine monohydrate 5g daily
    - Vitamin B12 2500 mcg weekly or as per label
    - Vitamin D3 2000 IU daily (if limited sun)
  VEGAN_PROTEIN_OPTIMIZATION_TIPS:
    - combine complementary proteins across meals
    - leverage fortified foods to hit micronutrient needs (iron, calcium, zinc)
  HYDRATION:
    2.2–3.0 liters/day minimum, more around training

NOTES
  - Client is 26, female, vegan, recreational lifter; program emphasizes progressive overload with phased hypertrophy emphasis and eventual strength maintenance.
  - Full gym access assumed; substitute machines/free weights as available.
  - Ensure nutrition plan targets 150g protein/day from plant sources; monitor progress and adjust calories to support muscle gain.
